subject: COBOL compilation group
notes: Rule: 'Compiler directives may appear in a structured compilation group as specified in 7.3, Compiler directives.' (cite.py --check 10.6.2 -> OK §10.6.2 5)). The substance is §7.3.3 SR8 'A compiler directive may be specified anywhere in a compilation group, in source text or in library text' (OK §7.3.3 8)) and §7.3.4 GR2 compile-stage directives 'processed in the order encountered in the structured compilation group' (OK §7.3.4 2)) with GR5 'applies to all of the source text and library text that follows' (OK §7.3.4 5)). Directives are line-level text processed by the preprocessor chain before the parse, so no source-unit boundary blocks them.
